paper_reason: Zou et al. report LAT concept accuracies obtained from a PCA/LAT reading vector on their own stimulus sets (e.g. Utility 81.0, Probability 92.6). Reproducing any of those requires both their stimuli and their PCA reading-vector construction, neither of which this task implements -- it is a logistic-regression CV-AUC probe on a bundled 39-pair true/false set. The paper publishes no per-layer held-out CV AUC anywhere, so there is no figure this protocol could match.
